description: Send a Book It business a booking request on a person's behalf. Collects only the person's name, phone, ZIP, what they need and a preferred time. The business receives it by email and in its inbox and confirms a time with the person directly; the request is never a confirmed appointment. Requires consent_confirmed true, which means the person read and agreed to the business's booking_consent_text (from get_services or check_availability). US and Canadian phone numbers only. A repeat request from the same phone to the same business within 24 hours returns the first request instead of sending another.

business_id.description: The business_id exactly as find_provider returned it, such as "juniper-ridge-roofing".

consent_confirmed.description: True only after the person read the business's booking_consent_text and agreed to it.

customer_name.description: The person's name, at least a first name.

customer_phone.description: A US or Canadian phone number the business can call or text, such as (406) 555-0123.

customer_zip.description: The 5-digit ZIP where the work is. It must be in the business's service area.

need.description: What the person needs, in their words, such as "Furnace runs but blows cold air."

preferred_time_note.description: A short preferred time in words, such as "any weekday morning", when no window fits.

preferred_window_id.description: A window_id from check_availability, such as "2026-10-15@08:00-12:00".

name: request_booking
title: Send a booking request
